resources.string: Share the bar\'s items with other apps

Lets apps you allow read what the bar shows: each item\'s icon and words, which can be a track\'s title or a meeting\'s name. Each app still asks Android for your permission first. Applies to this device, not to one layout.
read the bar\'s items from BentoBar
Read what BentoBar\'s bar shows, each item\'s icon and words, while BentoBar\'s sharing is on.
